payload.title: Make repeated source-grounding packet preflight preserve distinct operation logs
payload.summary: Priority2 historical active-analysis/controller adapter reliability. discrimination.lifecycle.run(packet_validate) uses root.parent/(case+"-candidate-cli-preflight") for every validation. PACKET validation creates exclusive stdout.log; pre-C validation repeats the same destination and raises FileExistsError before C ENTERED or gold invocation. Candidate08 original stderr and terminal pipeline receipt independently establish this impact, not just synthetic exploitability. A new harmless Python-version-like process invoked twice through workers.command at one destination reproduces the collision. No production ToolRunner/WorkCycle caller found.
payload.benefit: Preserve original frozen source, grants and all receipts. If future analysis is separately authorized, provide a versioned adapter using distinct operation-occurrence log destinations or authenticated read-only reuse of exact unchanged version evidence. Preserve exclusive creation, original logs, current configuration binding and pre-entry capacity/authority checks. Independent fake-process integration must exercise packet_validate then C-pre-entry validation, retain both receipts, reject mutated replay inputs and avoid automatic retry of scientific effects. Keep terminal pipeline failure dominant over journal-only SAFE_QUEUED projection; verify interrupted/failed outcomes stay non-resumable absent separately authorized reconciliation. No model needed for the regression and no revival of Candidate08 grant.
payload.uncertainty: Candidate08 is INCOMPLETE, not a negative scientific result. One concurrent B24 Sol turn completed locally but was quarantined; no Astra, gold import or D publication. Correction cannot retroactively accept that run. Framework process exclusivity is correct; adapter destination ownership is the defect.
